script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: STARS ALIGNED

INT. LOS ANGELES APARTMENT - DAY

Our HERO, JACKSON, late 20s, ambitious,
talented pianist, sits at his grand piano,
staring intently at the sheet music in front
of him. The sun shines in through the large
windows, illuminating the room.

JACKSON
(whispers to himself)
I've got this.

INT. LOS ANGELES CAFÉ - DAY

Jackson plays a live set at the café,
mesmerizing the audience with his music.
His FRIEND, EMMA, 20s, a talented painter,
watches from the crowd, admiring her
friend's talent. After the performance,
Emma approaches Jackson, a proud smile
on her face.

EMMA
(excited)
That was amazing!

JACKSON
(smiling)
Thanks, Emma.

EMMA
(hesitant)
You know what else is amazing? My new
exhibition at the Art Institute next week.
I've been working on it for months.

JACKSON
(genuinely interested)
That's fantastic! I'd love to come.

INT. LOS ANGELES APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jackson is working late into the night,
composing a new piece for an upcoming
competition. The phone rings, breaking the
silence.

JACKSON
(into phone)
Hello? Yes, this is Jackson.

(sighs)

JACKSON
(into phone)
I understand, but I need more time to
prepare. I'll make it work. Yes, I'll be there.

(hangs up the phone, frustrated)

INT. LOS ANGELES ART INSTITUTE - DAY

The day of Emma's exhibition. Jackson
arrives, impressed by the turnout and the
beauty of Emma's artwork. He mingles
with the crowd, making small talk.

EMMA
(approaching Jackson)
Hey, I'm so glad you could make it.

JACKSON
(smiling)
Of course. Your work is incredible.

EMMA
(looking at him)
And yours is too. I've been meaning
to tell you that.

JACKSON
(surprised)
Really?

EMMA
(nods)
Yes. You have a gift, Jackson. Don't let
it go to waste.

INT. LOS ANGELES APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jackson practices late into the night,
inspired by Emma's words. He plays his
newest composition, a beautiful and
emotional piece that captures his heart.

INT. LOS ANGELES CONCERT HALL - DAY

The day of the piano competition. Jackson
performs with passion and grace,
impressing the judges and the
audience. After the performance,
Jackson is announced as the winner.

EMMA
(from the audience, cheering)
You did it!

INT. LOS ANGELES APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jackson, filled with joy and
accomplishment, plays a joyful and
triumphant piece on his piano. He
glances up, noticing Emma sitting in the
darkness, watching him.

JACKSON
(smiling)
I couldn't have done it without you.

EMMA
(smiling back)
I knew you could.

They share a moment of mutual
admiration and understanding, their
friendship blossoming into something
more.

FADE OUT.
